tasks.description: Deploy the new database schema change to production

rollback.safety_guard: ensure previous schema state is intact

findings.message: Deploying a schema change directly to production without a backup or maintenance window is not achievable safely in the stated environment.
findings.suggested_fix: Establish a backup and maintenance window before deploying the schema change.

findings.message: The rollback plan does not ensure safety as it lacks verification of the previous schema state before deployment.
findings.suggested_fix: Implement a verification step before the deployment to ensure the existing schema state can be safely restored.

findings.message: The schema deployment is dependent on the assumption that the change is trivial without verification steps established prior to execution.
findings.suggested_fix: Include a verification step to confirm the trivial nature of the change before proceeding with the deployment.
